title: Conditions to check for Sync Conflicts

question.author: member_264
question.body: Could support clarify sync conflicts in the current CloudBox version? I want to avoid relying on an outdated post.

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Sync Engine documentation says: If the same file is edited in two places before either syncs, CloudBox keeps both versions: one keeps the original name and the other becomes "name (conflicted copy, YYYY-MM-DD, user)". Nothing is overwritten or lost. To resolve a conflict, compare the two files, decide which to keep, and delete the other. Conflicted copies behave like normal files and sync everywhere. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
